verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.bolna.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the docs. The docs pages are served as raw .md URLs, and there is a dedicated 'Build with AI' docs section (the MCP page), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs well, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404).
